craft_notes: Sthāyin: face-returns (support perished → HIS face manifested: the face-refrain #4 with v124's own-face). Rows: row 3 (perished→manifested). Close: manifested (vyaktam — the face as what display leaves: face-display-refrain with v110's manifest-only). Rejected: 'mirror gaze' — killed: own face kept (the mirror stays implicit in own-face); 'ego death' again — killed: support perished kept (the support, not the face, dies).

lines: Sense-based support for one's own face:
at end perished — Bhairava's own face manifested.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na dveṣam bhāvayet kvāpi na rāgam bhāvayet kvacit | rāgadveṣavinirmuktau madhye brahma prasarpati

reads_against.argmap: What glides in the middle? → Neither passion nor hatred — brahman glides forth in the middle between them.
c1_essence: Neither hatred nor passion contemplated: brahman glides middle.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra with śānta undertow (resolve laid quiet)
